name: UMANG (Unified Mobile App for New-age Governance)
description: Single mobile app aggregating central, state, and utility services (EPFO, income tax, passport, bill pay, etc.).
benefits: One app for many government services; multilingual; Aadhaar/PAN-based auth.
eligibility: Any citizen with a smartphone; services may need respective IDs.
fees: Free app; service charges as applicable.
languages_available: Hindi, English and multiple Indian languages
